adaptation: One Markdown per session; verbatim turn text, speakers, dialog IDs, timestamp and supplied BLIP captions. No QA answers, generated observations or summaries in retrieval.
limitations: Session-level evidence recall is not official QA F1 or answer accuracy.
Caption-marked sessions do not prove image availability or multimodal correctness.
Adversarial questions require reader evaluation; candidate counts cannot measure abstention.
Development results may guide optimization; three conversation holdouts remain unevaluated.
